works: Dual-axis virtualization (TanStack rows+cols, overscan 12/4) with sticky header, sticky row-number gutter, and a sticky draft-row band — handles 50k rows without DOM blowup
Streaming rows buffered per tab+statement and flushed on rAF (results.ts:92-128); background tab streams never touch the visible tab (byTab mirror)
Selection: rect/row/col/select-all via drag, shift-extend, arrows, ⌘+arrow edge-jump, ⌘A; corner click selects all
Copy in 5 formats (TSV/CSV/JSON/Markdown/INSERT) via ⌘C + right-click Copy-as submenu on a real keyboard-navigable nested ContextMenu

Inline cell editing: double-click/Enter, Esc cancels without blur-save race, ⌘⇧⌫ stages NULL, JSON cells route to inspector; dirty ✎ badge, commit-preview modal (one transaction, SQL shown), green flash on success

Editability map drives per-column type icons, read-only reasons on hover, ctid-edit amber warning; Set NULL / Set EMPTY over selection; multi-row delete gated on single-table locator with confirm preview
Inline draft insert row with NULL vs DEFAULT semantics (untouched → column default), ⌘↵/Esc, error band
Column resize by drag with sane min/max; initial widths estimated from a 100-row sample
Multi-statement chips with per-statement error/rowcount/timing; status bar shows rows, capped indicator, ms, pending-edit count with Commit/Discard links
Truncated-cell (…⧉) marker wired to inspector full-value fetch; NULL rendered dim-italic; danger confirm for no-WHERE statements before run

gaps.title: Stale selection survives re-run/filter/statement-switch → crash or corrupt staged edits
gaps.detail: useSelection state (Grid.tsx:161) is never reset when statement.index changes, rows shrink after a re-run/filter, or the user switches statement chips. copySelection (Grid.tsx:251) does rows[r].slice on rows that no longer exist → TypeError crash on ⌘C; setSelectionValue (Grid.tsx:322-330) stages edits with undefined original against phantom rows; deleteSelectedRows (Grid.tsx:363) builds locators from undefined rows. Repro: select 200 rows, add a filter that returns 50, ⌘C → crash. Fix: reset anchor/focus in an effect keyed on (statement.index, rows.length shrink, columns identity) and clamp rect to bounds inside copySelection/setSelectionValue/deleteSelectedRows.

gaps.title: Any re-run silently destroys pending edits — including infinite-scroll load-more
gaps.detail: results.run (results.ts:185) unconditionally calls edits.resetTab, wiping staged edits with zero warning. Browser load-more (browser.ts:196) re-runs the query, so merely SCROLLING a table you're editing discards your staged cell edits; same for sort/filter change or ⌘Enter re-run. Direct 'never lose work' violation. Fix: if pending edits exist for the tab, route through the existing closeGuard-style confirm (keep/discard/commit) before run(); long-term key edits by PK so they survive re-fetch.

gaps.title: Opening the editor on a NULL cell and clicking away stages NULL → '' silently
gaps.detail: startEdit seeds draft with current ?? '' (Grid.tsx:223) and blur always saves (Grid.tsx:91-94), so double-click a NULL cell + click elsewhere stages an edit changing NULL to empty string — a data corruption footgun invisible until commit. Fix: track that the draft started as NULL; on save, if the text was never modified, keep NULL (no edit staged); render a NULL placeholder inside the editor instead of ''.

gaps.title: Right-click doesn't retarget selection; no menu at all without a selection
gaps.detail: onContextMenu (Grid.tsx:429-432) only opens the menu if sel.rect exists and never moves selection to the cell under the cursor — right-clicking cell X while cells Y are selected runs Copy/Set NULL/Delete against Y (wrong data), and right-clicking a fresh grid does nothing. Every mature client selects-then-menus. Fix: on contextmenu, hit-test the cell; if outside the current rect, set anchor=focus=that cell before opening the menu.

gaps.title: Copy-as-INSERT emits `your_table`, unquoted identifiers, and includes ctid
gaps.detail: [known] clipboard.ts:16 hardcodes table='your_table' — Grid.tsx:255 never passes the real name even though editMap.tables has it. Also names.join(', ') (clipboard.ts:48) emits unquoted identifiers (breaks on mixed-case/reserved words like "order"), and in browser mode the injected ctid column (browser.ts:121) is included → invalid INSERT. Fix: thread editMap.tables[oid] into formatCells, quote idents with the existing qi(), and exclude is_ctid columns from all copy formats.

gaps.title: NULL vs empty-string vs literal 'NULL' text render identically
gaps.detail: [known] Grid.tsx:606 renders v===null as the text 'NULL' (styled) but a text cell containing 'NULL' looks identical at a glance, and '' renders as blank indistinguishable from whitespace. The grid lies about data. Fix: dedicated dim NULL chip element (not text), an ∅/·empty· marker for '', part of one value-rendering pass shared with copy/find.

gaps.title: No find-in-results (⌘F)
gaps.detail: [known] Zero find over loaded rows — no match highlight, count, next/prev, jump-to-cell. Table stakes in every competitor; the roadmap's honest-loaded-rows design ("found N in X loaded of M") is right. Wire ⌘F on the focused grid surface in Grid.tsx keydown.

gaps.title: No click-header-to-sort or client-side sort for query results
gaps.detail: [known] Header click starts column-selection drag (Grid.tsx:479) — no sort anywhere for editor-mode results; browser mode hides sort in a separate toolbar popover (TableBrowser.tsx:192) so the two grids behave inconsistently. Fix: header click (or dedicated affordance) = tri-state client-side sort over loaded rows with a sort glyph in the header; keep a stable row-index map so edits/selection survive.

gaps.title: No export to file (CSV/JSON/SQL)
gaps.detail: [known] Copy is clipboard-only; a 50k-row result cannot be saved. Needs save dialog + streamed writer (or COPY TO STDOUT via backend) reachable from grid context menu + palette.

gaps.title: Grid keyboard nav is arrows-only: no PageUp/Down, Home/End, Tab, Enter-advance, type-to-edit, Delete
gaps.detail: [known, partially] onKeyDown (Grid.tsx:274-312) handles only arrows/⌘arrows/⌘C/⌘A/Enter. Missing: PageUp/Down (viewport jump), Home/End (row start/end), ⌘Home/End, Tab/Shift-Tab move-and-edit, Enter-saves-then-advances-down, F2, typing a printable char replaces cell content and opens editor (spreadsheet standard), Delete/Backspace stages NULL/empty on selection, Esc clears selection, ⇧Space/⌃Space row/col select. 'Keyboard-first' ideology; only arrows exist.

gaps.title: Cells unmemoized — entire visible window re-renders on every arrow key, drag step, and stream flush
gaps.detail: [known] Grid.tsx:581-612 renders cells inline in the map with fresh closures; any sel/focus/pending/flash change re-renders ~all visible cells (500-col tables = thousands). React.memo a Cell component keyed on (value, selected, focused, dirty, flash, width, truncated, warn) — the single biggest perf win.

gaps.title: Drag-select writes to the store per cell crossed, no pointer capture, no autoscroll
gaps.detail: [known, partially] dragOver fires setFocus per mouseenter (Grid.tsx:603, useSelection.ts:63-73) — O(cells) full re-renders per swipe, and fast drags skip cells entirely since mouseenter misses. Also no edge-autoscroll: dragging below/right of the viewport cannot extend selection past visible rows (Excel/TablePlus scroll automatically). Fix: pointer capture + document-level pointermove hit-testing from coordinates + rAF-coalesced focus writes + edge autoscroll loop.

gaps.title: No undo/redo of staged edits
gaps.detail: [known] ⌘Z does nothing; a fat-fingered Set NULL over 500 cells is only recoverable by Discard ALL edits. Per-tab undo stack over immutable pending snapshots in edits.ts.

gaps.title: TSV/CSV copy corrupts values: NULL and '' both copy as empty, embedded newlines break row structure, tabs lossily become 4 spaces
gaps.detail: clipboard.ts:21-29 — TSV replaces tabs with spaces (silent data mutation) and leaves \n raw so a multiline cell splits into two rows when pasted into Sheets/Excel; CSV escape misses \r (clipboard.ts:7). NULL vs '' indistinguishable in both. Fix: Excel-convention quote TSV cells containing \t/\n/", add \r to csvEscape, and offer a NULL-sentinel option.

gaps.title: Missing copy variants: copy-with-headers, copy cell raw, copy column name(s), copy as IN-list
gaps.detail: [known] TSV (the ⌘C default) has no header option (clipboard.ts:21); no single-cell 'Copy value' (raw, unformatted); no 'Copy column name' / 'Copy as IN (…)' from a selected column. Add ⌘⇧C copy-with-headers + menu items; IN-list from column selection is a daily SQL-author move.

gaps.title: A late global error wipes streamed results off the screen
gaps.detail: ResultsPane.tsx:15-23 early-returns the error pane whenever globalError is set — a mid-stream connection drop replaces 30k already-visible rows with an error page ('never lose work' violation). Fix: render globalError as a banner above the grid when statements exist; keep the data browsable.

gaps.title: Scroll and active-statement position not reset on new run — new results open scrolled to the bottom
gaps.detail: No scrollTo on statement change in Grid.tsx: re-running while scrolled deep leaves scrollTop clamped to the new (smaller) scrollHeight, so results appear starting mid/bottom. Fix: rowVirt.scrollToIndex(0) + colVirt reset when statement.index/executedSql changes (but NOT on browser load-more append).

gaps.title: Drag mode gets stuck when mouseup lands outside the grid/window
gaps.detail: endDrag only fires on the container's onMouseUp (Grid.tsx:428); press, drag out of the window, release, re-enter → selection keeps following the cursor with no button held until the next click. Fix: window-level mouseup/pointerup listener (or pointer capture, which fixes this and drag-skips together).

gaps.title: Column widths reset on every re-run; no autofit; not persisted
gaps.detail: widthsInitialized resets on statement.columns identity change (Grid.tsx:124-126) which happens EVERY run — hand-resized widths vanish on refresh, filter change, and browser load-more. No double-click-divider autofit, no fit-all-columns. Fix: key widths by column-name signature so identical shapes keep widths across runs; dbl-click divider = autofit from loaded rows; persist per table/query-shape in appdb [known, v0.5 P2 for persistence — the reset-on-rerun part is unlisted and worse].

gaps.title: No selection stats in status bar (count/sum/avg/min/max) or cell coordinates
gaps.detail: Status bar (ResultsPane.tsx:68-81) shows row count + ms only. TablePlus/DataGrip show 'SUM 4,502 · AVG 37.5 · COUNT 120' for a numeric selection — the user explicitly wants this. Compute lazily from sel.rect over loaded rows (numeric-parse with locale-safe fallback), plus 'R12:C4' focused-cell indicator and column count.

gaps.title: No paste into grid, no fill-down, no type-once-fill-selection
gaps.detail: [known] ⌘V does nothing; setSelectionValue machinery (Grid.tsx:315) exists but only NULL/EMPTY. Paste single value into whole selection, paste TSV block into matching rect, ⌘D fill-down.

gaps.title: Cell editor is a single-line input — multiline text values can't be edited or entered
gaps.detail: CellEditor (Grid.tsx:71-95) uses <input>; Enter always saves, so \n can neither be seen nor typed — editing a multiline text value flattens your view of it and there is no ⌥Enter. Fix: auto-grow textarea; Enter saves, ⌥/⇧Enter inserts newline; or route multiline values to the inspector like JSON.

gaps.title: Text starting with [ or { is misrouted to the JSON inspector editor
gaps.detail: [known, adjacent] startEdit heuristic (Grid.tsx:213-216) sends any cell matching /^\s*[[{]/ to the inspector even when type_name is text — e.g. value '[draft]' can't be edited inline and risks the known structuredValue JSON-corruption path (format.ts). Fix: gate on type_name ∈ {json,jsonb,array} only.

gaps.title: Cell editor renders at (0,0) when the target cell is scrolled out of the virtual window
gaps.detail: [known] Grid.tsx:617-618 uses find() over virtual items with ?? 0 fallback — scrolling while editing teleports the editor to the top-left corner where blur-save can silently fire. Fix: compute position from rowVirt offsets directly (start = index*ROW_H) and clamp to viewport, or close/park the editor when the cell leaves the window.

gaps.title: 'unavailable' editability gives no reason; double-click on read-only is a silent no-op
gaps.detail: When editMap is 'unavailable' (editability fetch failed / view / non-SELECT), colEditMeta returns undefined → cells have no title, no reason, and double-click does nothing with zero feedback (Grid.tsx:590-604). Violates 'read-only cells say why'. Fix: statement-level banner or per-cell title ('editability unknown: <error>'), and a subtle shake/toast on rejected edit attempts.

gaps.title: Context menu density: no Filter-by-value, Open-in-inspector, Copy cell, Set DEFAULT, Revert cell, Duplicate row, row-detail
gaps.detail: [known — menu epic] Current menu (Grid.tsx:638-673) = Copy, Copy-as, Set NULL/EMPTY, Delete. Missing the per-surface density that makes clients feel mature: cell → Filter by this value / exclude value / open inspector / copy raw / set DEFAULT / revert this cell (clearEdit exists unwired, edits.ts:139); row-number gutter → select/duplicate/copy-as-INSERT/delete; header → sort/hide/copy name/IN-list/distinct values. Build on the existing ContextMenu primitive.

gaps.title: No FK follow / jump-to-referenced-row
gaps.detail: [known] FK columns render as plain text; no cmd-click or menu item to open the referenced table filtered to that key — the loved 'magic' affordance in TablePlus/DataGrip. FkInfo exists in introspection; wire cell → openTable(fk target) with a filter preset.

gaps.title: No column hide, pin/freeze, or reorder
gaps.detail: [known] 500-column tables force horizontal scrolling with no way to hide noise or freeze id/name. Hide is cheap (filter the column index map before virtualization); pin/reorder are the v0.45 stretch.

gaps.title: ⌘A + Copy on a 50k-row result freezes the main thread; copy failures are silent
gaps.detail: copySelection (Grid.tsx:245-258) synchronously builds the full string (JSON pretty-print of 50k×30 can be >100MB) then ships it over Tauri IPC; multi-second beachball, possible clipboard failure reported only to console (line 255 .catch(console.error)). Fix: size guard + toast ('copied 50,000 rows'), chunked/deferred formatting for large rects, error toast on failure.

gaps.title: Focus movement triggers a dynamic import + inspector store write per arrow key
gaps.detail: Grid.tsx:191-199 runs import('../stores/inspector') then setTarget on every focus change — a promise tick + inspector re-render (JSON tree work) per keystroke while arrowing through cells. Hoist to a static import and debounce/idle-schedule setTarget (~80ms) so held-arrow navigation stays 60fps [known adjacent: hoist-imports track].

gaps.title: No quick-look/tooltip for overflowed cells
gaps.detail: [known] Ellipsized cells show no hover preview and Space does nothing; only route is selecting + reading the inspector. Space-to-peek popover + delayed hover tooltip with the full (loaded) value.

gaps.title: No client-side quick-filter over loaded rows
gaps.detail: [known] Editor-mode results have zero filtering; browser filters re-query the server per change. A local 'show only rows where col = value' / text filter over loaded rows complements find-in-results.

gaps.title: Numerics not right-aligned; no bytea/date/array-aware rendering
gaps.detail: [known — value-rendering pass] All cells left-aligned mono (grid.css:273); numeric columns should right-align with tabular-nums, bytea should show '\x… (N bytes)', timestamptz needs the UTC/local toggle. Type info is available via editMap type_name.

gaps.title: Browser-mode ctid column is shown and copied as if it were data
gaps.detail: browseSql injects ctid for PK-less tables (browser.ts:121) and the grid renders it as an ordinary first column — included in TSV/CSV/JSON/INSERT copies and row selections. Fix: hide locator columns from display/copy (keep for locators), or at minimum badge it and exclude from copy formats.

gaps.title: Draft row cannot insert an empty string; autofocus fails when first column is virtualized out
gaps.detail: commitDraft skips cells with text==='' (browser.ts:244) so '' is unreachable — only NULL or DEFAULT; no explicit DEFAULT vs empty control. Draft autofocus is tied to the first draft col being IN the virtual window (Grid.tsx:543). Fix: track touched-vs-untouched per cell (touched+'' → insert ''), scrollTo first col on beginDraft.

gaps.title: Commit result/index misalignment risk between stmtEdits and outcome.results
gaps.detail: buildRowEdits filters out non-editable edits (edits.ts:77 continue) while commit maps outcome.results[i] positionally onto the UNFILTERED stmtEdits (edits.ts:214-227) — if the two ever diverge (map refetch, future code paths), wrong cells get patched with wrong new_values and flashed. Latent today (edits only staged on editable cols) but a data-lie time bomb. Fix: build a parallel array of the edits actually sent and map results against that.

gaps.title: Commit clears pending edits for statements whose editability map was loading/unavailable
gaps.detail: commit skips those statements (edits.ts:207-210) but then writeEdits(pending:{}) (edits.ts:232) wipes ALL pending — the skipped statements' edits are silently dropped, never applied. Fix: clear only the keys actually committed; surface 'N edits skipped (no editability)' in lastError.

gaps.title: Delete rows nukes scroll/selection via full re-run; no Delete-key shortcut
gaps.detail: deleteSelectedRows re-runs executedSql (Grid.tsx:390) — scroll position, selection, and column widths all reset after deleting one row. Fix: splice deleted rows from the statement locally (patchStatement exists) and reconcile on next manual refresh; wire ⌘⌫ to delete-selected-rows with the same confirm.

gaps.title: First ArrowDown with no selection skips row 0
gaps.detail: moveFocus bases on focus ?? {r:0,c:0} then ADDS the delta (useSelection.ts:80-82) — pressing ArrowDown in a fresh grid focuses row 1, never row 0. Fix: when focus is null, land on (0,0) regardless of direction.

gaps.title: CJK/emoji columns sized too narrow by width estimation
gaps.detail: estimateWidths uses UTF-16 v.length × CHAR_W 7.3 (Grid.tsx:27-39) — double-width CJK and emoji-heavy columns get ~half the needed width, ellipsizing everything. Fix: cheap wide-char heuristic (codepoint ranges count ×2) or canvas measureText on the sample.

gaps.title: Copy-as-JSON emits all values as strings and collides duplicate column names
gaps.detail: clipboard.ts:31-34 — numbers/booleans/null-vs-'null' all become strings, and SELECT a.id, b.id yields one 'id' key (Object.fromEntries keeps last). Fix: type-aware coercion via editMap type_name; suffix duplicate keys id, id_2.

gaps.title: Markdown copy breaks on newlines in cells
gaps.detail:
clipboard.ts:36-42 escapes | but leaves \n raw, splitting the markdown table row. Replace \n with
inside cells.

gaps.title: Statement chips overflow unmanaged; no keyboard statement switching
gaps.detail: A 30-statement script renders 30 chips in a no-wrap flex row (grid.css:34-39) with no overflow-x scroll; no ⌘1-9/⌃Tab to switch statements; clicking a chip mid-run gets yanked back because every statement_start forces activeStatement (results.ts:194).

gaps.title: Zero-row result renders a blank void
gaps.detail: Columns render but the body is empty with no '0 rows' hint in the grid area (only tiny status-bar text) — looks broken on first use. Centered 'Query OK — 0 rows' empty state under the header.

gaps.title: Column resize re-measures the whole column virtualizer per mousemove
gaps.detail: onResizeStart's onMove calls setWidths per pixel (Grid.tsx:404-408) which triggers colVirt.measure() (Grid.tsx:157-159) + full re-render each event — visible jank on 200+ column results. rAF-throttle the move handler; measure once on mouseup or per frame.

gaps.title: No discontiguous selection (⌘-click rows/cells) or keyboard row/col selection
gaps.detail: Selection model is a single rect (useSelection.ts) — no ⌘-click to add ranges, no ⇧Space/⌃Space select row/column. TablePlus supports multi-row discontiguous selection for delete/copy. Requires rect-list selection model.

gaps.title: No stop/cancel affordance in the results pane while running
gaps.detail: Status bar shows '⏳ running' (ResultsPane.tsx:69) but no cancel button — ⌘. is the only path and it's undiscoverable mid-stream on a runaway query. Add a Stop button next to the running indicator wired to results.cancel().

gaps.title: Row-number gutter breaks past ~7-digit rows and numbers aren't locale-formatted
gaps.detail: ROWNUM_W fixed 52px (Grid.tsx:24); once load-more-past-50k lands, 1,000,000+ overflows the gutter. Compute gutter width from rows.length digits.

gaps.title: Flash-clear timer races across quick successive commits
gaps.detail: commit schedules setTimeout(clear all flash, 900) per commit (edits.ts:229) — a second commit within 900ms gets its flash wiped early by the first timer. Track per-key timestamps or a generation counter.

gaps.title: Per-cell inline closures and string-built classNames churn GC at scale
gaps.detail: Each visible cell allocates 3 event handlers + template className per render (Grid.tsx:592-609); with 500 visible cells × re-render-per-drag-step this compounds the unmemoized-cell cost. After memoizing cells, move mouse handling to container-level event delegation using data-r/data-c attributes.

gaps.title: EditPreview lacks copy-SQL and per-edit control
gaps.detail: [known, partially] Modal (EditPreview.tsx) shows the batch SQL but has no Copy button, no per-statement checkbox/discard, no old→new value diff — it's commit-all-or-cancel. Copy-SQL is trivial (statements already strings).

perf_risks: Unmemoized cell render: every selection/focus/drag/pending/flash/stream-flush change re-renders all visible cells (Grid.tsx:581-612); at 500-col × 40-row windows this is thousands of React elements per keystroke — the primary 60fps threat [known]

dragOver → setFocus store write per cell crossed with no rAF coalescing or pointer capture (useSelection.ts:63, Grid.tsx:603) — O(cells) full re-renders per drag swipe, plus mouseenter misses cells on fast drags [known]
Column resize: setWidths + colVirt.measure() per mousemove pixel (Grid.tsx:404-408, 157-159) — full column re-layout per event on wide results
Focus-change effect runs a dynamic import + inspector setTarget per arrow key (Grid.tsx:191-199) → promise tick + inspector subtree re-render per navigation keystroke

copySelection builds the entire formatted string synchronously then one giant Tauri IPC clipboard call (Grid.tsx:245-258) — ⌘A+⌘C on 50k×30 (especially JSON pretty-print) freezes the main thread for seconds

Streaming: each rAF flush rebuilds the statements array (results.ts:118-124) → full ResultsPane+Grid re-render per flush; combined with unmemoized cells, ~100 whole-window repaints during a 50k-row stream; rows appended via O(n) array spread per flush
setSelectionValue issues one setEdit store write per cell in the rect, each spreading the whole pending Record — O(N²) for large rects, one full grid re-render per cell (Grid.tsx:315-335) [known]

Browser infinite scroll re-runs the whole query with LIMIT+1000 each page (browser.ts:196-204) — O(n²) rows streamed/decoded over a deep-scroll session, and each re-run resets widths/selection/pending edits [known — keyset pagination]
estimateWidths re-runs O(100×cols) on every statement columns-identity change, i.e. every run including load-more pages (Grid.tsx:124-133)
Per-cell handler closure allocation (3/cell) + template className construction per render — GC churn that compounds once cell memoization lands unless handlers are hoisted/delegated

Unbounded in-DOM cell text: 8KB backend cap × ~500 visible cells ≈ up to 4MB of text nodes in the layout pass on pathological wide-text results — consider a display-length clamp (~1KB) with the full value in inspector only
PendingEditsStatus selector Object.keys(s.pending).length allocates a key array on every edits-store change (ResultsPane.tsx:88) — trivial today, avoidable with a counter
